views.not_allowed: This button can only be used by the person that triggered the command.
views.help_footer:
-# **Need help?**
-# Ask in the [support server]({support}) or check the [documentation]({docs})
views.captcha_disabled: Captcha verification is currently disabled for this server.
views.captcha_pending: You already have a captcha pending. Please check your DMs.
views.captcha_dm_body: Type the code shown in the image below to verify you are human.
views.captcha_dm_footer: -# The code is **case-insensitive**. You have **3 attempts**.
views.captcha_sent: A captcha has been sent to your DMs. Please check and reply with the code.
views.captcha_dm_blocked: I couldn't send you a DM. Please enable DMs from server members and try again.
views.verified_no_guild: Verification passed! However, I could not find the server to apply roles.
views.verified_no_member: Verification passed! However, I could not find you in the server.
views.web_unavailable: The verification page is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
views.web_body:
Open the page below and type the code it shows.

The roles you need are added automatically as soon as the page confirms you.

views.panel_intro:
Before you can access this server, you need to prove you're human.

{prompt}
views.prompt_click:
Click **Verify** below to confirm you are human.

That is the whole check — the roles you need will be added straight away.
views.prompt_image: Click **Verify** below and the bot will send you a DM with a captcha image. Reply to the DM with the code shown in the image.
views.prompt_web: Click **Verify** below to open a short verification page in your browser. Type the code it shows and you are done — keep Discord open so the roles arrive.
views.rules_footer: -# Click the button below to acknowledge the rules.
views.rules_default: No rules have been set yet.
views.help_intro: Setup onboarding for your server to help new members get started without requiring an entire staff team to welcome them!
views.help_commands:
**`{prefix}onboarding setup`** — Setup onboarding for the server.
**`{prefix}onboarding role-menu`** — Setup role menu for the server.
**`{prefix}onboarding autoroles`** — Configure auto-assigned roles on join.
**`{prefix}onboarding captcha`** — Configure captcha human verification.
views.captcha_failed_body: You have failed the captcha verification.
views.captcha_kicked: You have been kicked from the server.
views.captcha_retry: Return to the server and click **Verify** again to get a new captcha.
views.captcha_attempts_left: You have **{count}** attempt(s) left. Here is a new captcha:
views.guild_only: This must be used in a server.
views.rules_role_prompt: Reply in this channel with a role mention, ID, or name within 60 seconds.
views.rules_role_not_found: Could not find that role. Use a mention, ID, or name.
views.field_description_hint: Use {user} for mention, {name} for username, {guild} for the server.
views.color_invalid: Color must be a six-digit hex value such as {example}.

views.wizard_hint_button_single: Buttons — picking one clears any other role in this menu

views.mode_click_description: Pressing **Verify** completes verification on the spot.
views.mode_image_description: Pressing **Verify** sends a captcha image in DMs; the member replies with the code.
views.mode_web_description: Pressing **Verify** opens a short captcha page in the browser. Proxy and VPN checks are available here.
